terms.definition: The amount of space a 3D object fills.
terms.function: Counted in cubic units packed inside.
terms.whereItIs: The space inside the clear box.

terms.definition: A 1-by-1-by-1 cube used to pack and count a solid.
terms.function: The building block of volume measurement.
terms.whereItIs: Each small cube inside the box.
terms.whyItMatters: Volume numbers are counts of these cubes.

terms.definition: The bottom slab of cubes — the area of length × width.
terms.whereItIs: The bottom slab of the box.
terms.whyItMatters: Base area × height is the volume formula in pictures.

terms.definition: How much liquid or material an object can hold.
terms.function: Equal to the volume inside the container.
terms.whereItIs: The water level at the brim.
terms.whyItMatters: Capacity turns volume into water, soil, and air we use.
